title: Bedrockite Armor
description: This mod is an addon for Bedrockite that makes the armor upgradeable to Bedrockite material.
body:
# Bedrockite Armor Addon

**Bedrockite Armor** is an addon for **Bedrockite** that introduces upgrading the netherite armor into the unstoppable Bedrockite variant.

## Features

* **Armor Upgrades:** Take your existing helmets, chestplates, leggings, and boots, and upgrade them using Bedrockite resources to unlock their ultimate potential.
* **Ultimate Durability & Protection:** Transform your everyday gear into armor pieces that match the absolute strength and defense of the Bedrockite tier.
* **Seamless Integration:** Works perfectly alongside the base Bedrockite mod, expanding your endgame options and survival progression.

---

## Dependecy

Bedrockite [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/bedrockite)

---
